name: Kansas
standard: ITEC 1210 (Revised Section 508; Rev 3 = WCAG 2.0 AA, Rev 4 reportedly WCAG 2.1 AA)

laws.summary: Lets the Information Technology Executive Council adopt IT policies for state entities.
Directs the Kansas Partnership for Accessible Technology to recommend accessibility policy to ITEC.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: ITEC 1210-P Revision 4 – ICT Accessibility Policy (not opened; 403)
ITEC Policy 1210 Revision 3 (revised 2018-12-11), as republished on smartweb.ks.gov

applies_to: All branches, boards, commissions, departments, divisions and agencies of state government.

deadlines.what: Rev 3: all entity ICT to conform within 18 months of publication (approximate, from the 2018-12-11 revision)
Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: ICT must conform to Revised 508 Chapters 3–7; public-facing content and official communications must meet WCAG AA
Written undue-burden or best-meets exceptions with cost estimates and a remediation timeline, approved by the State ADA Coordinator before deployment
Heads of entities set compliance procedures; KPAT reviews the policy yearly
mobile: implied — software, applications and platform software (including mobile systems) are covered through Section 508 terms; mobile apps are not named.
procurement: Standards apply to ICT procured or provided through contracts; best-meets exception requires documented market research.
enforcement: Administrative through the State ADA Coordinator and KPAT; no statutory remedy found.
notes: ebit.ks.gov returned 403, so Revision 4's date and its WCAG 2.1 AA requirement (§ 6.2.3 per search snippet) are unverified. Only Revision 3 (WCAG 2.0) was read. office_url comes from search results and was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
